# BRAHMA Sovereign Frontier AI Matrix

> BRAHMA is a sovereign planetary AI operating system orchestrating 50+ Global Frontier AI models, 13 Divine Intelligence Councils, 289+ Autonomous Swarm Agents, 1.58-bit Ternary BitBLAS Silicon Acceleration, and Formal Lean 4 Verification.

## Core Capabilities
- **50+ Frontier Models**: Unified routing across Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek R1, OpenAI o3-mini, and local BitNet 1.58-bit ternary models.
- **13 Sovereign Councils**: Specialized autonomous councils (Brihaspati, Garuda, Dhanvantari, Kubera, Vishwakarma, etc.) equipped with persistent email routing, SMS, and memory vaults.
- **44 Autonomous Engines**: Continuous learning, epistemic Bayesian AGM revision, Merkle DAG checkpoints, closed-loop impedance robotics, quantum circuit optimization, and compiler synthesis.
- **ReAct Interleaved Reasoning**: 5-layer production defense (Context Compactor, Negative Circuit Breaker, Resilient Stale-Cache, Formal Invariant Asserts, ToolMiddleware Gate).
- **25 Cloudflare Planetary Capabilities**: Zero-port-forward Cloudflare Tunnels, $0 egress R2 storage, D1 serverless SQL, edge KV caching, and Turnstile bot armor.
- **VoxCPM Voice & Telephony**: Sub-80ms emotional acoustic prosody synthesis and real-time streaming audio in Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, and English.
